name: setup-player-obsolete-when-seated
description: Live pbd257: after the milty draft every seat had a faction and colour, yet two 'Setup a Player' (setup.player, startPlayerSetup) prompts stayed open at the front of a seated player's queue, ahead of 'Keep a secret objective'. Base: pbd257 save 25 (phase playerSetup, all seats set up). Re-posting the player-setup menu to every seat's cards-info thread must not leave any setup.player decision open: each targets a seat that is already set up (PlayerSetupKind.obsolete).
